Name: (CP) George to Hector Salamanca
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
Turn George into Hector Salamanca! Ding ding.

--

My take on a George to Hector Salamanca mod, matching to vanilla's art style. Also includes a config if you'd prefer just George with Hector's signature bell instead, best utilized via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu﻿[/url].

Note that this is a graphic mod only, and doesn't change dialogue. Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19999]OffPlace's Hector Salamanca Ding Dong Dialogue[/url] to pair with this mod for the full Hector Salamanca effect~

--

To install--
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using Notepad++ or program of your choice) to choose your desired combination
(default is
[b]characterwithbell: Hector[/b]
Alternatively, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Works in Stardew 1.6. Requires the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher. Choose preferred character with bell via config file generated on startup, or with Generic Mod Config Menu.
